title: Ho Tum Kahan Abbas
body:
Khayamein sheh me hai mehsar....
Ho tum kahan Abbas.....
Akele hogaye Sarwar....
Ho tum kahan Abbas....
1. Ajeeb yaas e takhte hai asmaan ko Hussain
Utha ke lasha e asgher ho tum kahan Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hussain seena e akber se khaich'ntey hai see'na
Ayyan hai hasr ka manzer ho tum kahan Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Sooweh Hussain chala aaraha hai sumre layei'n
Sambhale haatou mein khanjer ho tum kahan Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Pada hai khaak pe maqtal ki zakhm khay e huwe
Sawaa're dosh e payamber ho tum kahan Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Jala ne aag liye aa rahein hai ahle sitam
Khayamein aale payamber ho tum kahan Abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Rida ye cheen gayi aur jal gaye khayam e Hussain
Aseer hogayi khaahir ho tum kahan abbbas
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Pukarte rahe maqtal me har qadam pe wafa
Hussain ta dam e aaqir ho tum kahan Abbas
Azz....mohd Ali wafa
